module origen_088668 (
    input wire data_out_sign,
    input wire [6:0] point_address,
    input wire clk,
    input wire clk_dstb,
    input wire reset,
    input wire [7:0] address_L0,
    output reg [11:0] address_out,
    output wire read_en,
    output reg [1:0] mux_control,
    output reg dstb,
    output reg trsf
);

    // State definition
    localparam IDLE = 2'b00;
    localparam DATA_OUT = 2'b01;
    localparam RELEASE_DSTB = 2'b10;

    reg [1:0] state, next_state;
    reg [5:0] counter;
    reg con_sign;
    reg sign, sign_prev;
    reg [11:0] read_point;

    // State transition logic
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset)
            state <= IDLE;
        else
            state <= next_state;
    end

    // Next state logic
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            IDLE: next_state = sign ? DATA_OUT : IDLE;
            DATA_OUT: next_state = con_sign ? RELEASE_DSTB : DATA_OUT;
            RELEASE_DSTB: next_state = IDLE;
            default: next_state = IDLE;
        endcase
    end

    // Counter logic
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset)
            counter <= 6'b0;
        else if (state == DATA_OUT)
            counter <= counter + 1'b1;
        else
            counter <= 6'b0;
    end

    // Control signal generation
    always @(*) begin
        case (counter)
            6'd28: begin mux_control = 2'b10; con_sign = 1'b0; end
            6'd29: begin mux_control = 2'b11; con_sign = 1'b1; end
            default: begin
                if (counter <= 6'd15)
                    mux_control = 2'b00;
                else if (counter <= 6'd27)
                    mux_control = 2'b01;
                else
                    mux_control = 2'b00;
                con_sign = 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end

    // Address generation
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset)
            read_point <= 12'b0;
        else
            read_point <= {1'b0, address_L0[6:0], point_address[3:0]} + 12'd16;
    end

    always @(*) begin
        address_out = {read_point[11:4], counter[3:0]};
    end

    // Signal edge detection
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset) begin
            sign <= 1'b0;
            sign_prev <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            sign <= data_out_sign;
            sign_prev <= sign;
        end
    end

    // Output signal generation
    assign read_en = data_out_sign;

    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset) begin
        if (!reset) begin
            dstb <= 1'b0;
            trsf <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            dstb <= (state == DATA_OUT);
            trsf <= sign & ~sign_prev;
        end
    end

endmodule
